qualification: Common root block queue allocation and client mapping boundaries

isolation.result: PASS exit 0; all eight target checks reported the root-validated expected VMM data fault

limitations: The Intel composition does not yet include blk_virt, so Intel queue mappings and block I/O are not qualified here.
